1	"""
2	Evaluation pipeline for pretrained language models.
3	
4	Three evaluation axes:
5	  1. Perplexity on held-out FineWeb — measures language modeling quality.
6	     Uses sliding-window evaluation (stride = max_length // 2) for long docs.
7	  2. lm-eval-harness benchmarks (HellaSwag, MMLU) — measures downstream task quality.
8	     Calls lm_eval.simple_evaluate for standardized, reproducible evaluation.
9	  3. Generation quality — measures output diversity via Self-BLEU and Distinct-n.
10	     Self-BLEU: average pairwise 4-gram BLEU across 1000 generated texts (lower = more diverse).
11	     Distinct-n: ratio of unique n-grams to total n-grams for n=1,2,3 (higher = more diverse).
12	
13	Outputs:
14	  eval_results.json        — all metrics in one dict
15	  perplexity_details.json  — per-document perplexity breakdown
16	  generation_samples.jsonl — generated texts with metadata
17	  lm_eval_results/         — raw lm-eval-harness output
18	"""
19	
20	import argparse
21	import json
22	import math
23	import os
24	import random
25	from collections import Counter
26	from pathlib import Path
27	
28	import torch
29	from datasets import load_dataset
30	from tqdm import tqdm
31	from transformers import AutoModelForCausalLM, AutoTokenizer
32	
33	
34	def parse_args():
35	    p = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Evaluate a pretrained language model.")
36	    p.add_argument("--model_path", type=str, required=True,
37	                   help="Path to the model checkpoint directory")
38	    p.add_argument("--model_name", type=str, default=None,
39	                   help="Model name for lm-eval-harness (defaults to model_path)")
40	    p.add_argument("--output_dir", type=str, required=True,
41	                   help="Directory to save evaluation results")
42	    p.add_argument("--eval_data_path", type=str, default=None,
43	                   help="Local path to held-out eval data (JSONL with 'text' field)")
44	    p.add_argument("--fineweb_subset", type=str, default="sample-10BT",
45	                   help="FineWeb subset for streaming eval if eval_data_path is not set")
46	    p.add_argument("--num_eval_tokens", type=int, default=5_000_000,
47	                   help="Approximate number of tokens to evaluate perplexity on")
48	    p.add_argument("--max_length", type=int, default=2048,
49	                   help="Maximum sequence length for perplexity evaluation")
50	    p.add_argument("--batch_size", type=int, default=4,
51	                   help="Evaluation batch size")
52	    p.add_argument("--run_perplexity", type=lambda x: x.lower() != "false",
53	                   default=True, help="Run perplexity evaluation")
54	    p.add_argument("--run_lm_eval", type=lambda x: x.lower() != "false",
55	                   default=True, help="Run lm-eval-harness benchmarks")
56	    p.add_argument("--run_generation", type=lambda x: x.lower() != "false",
57	                   default=True, help="Run generation quality evaluation")
58	    p.add_argument("--lm_eval_tasks", type=str, default="hellaswag,mmlu",
59	                   help="Comma-separated lm-eval tasks")
60	    p.add_argument("--num_generation_samples", type=int, default=1000,
61	                   help="Number of texts to generate for diversity metrics")
62	    p.add_argument("--seed", type=int, default=42, help="Random seed")
63	    return p.parse_args()
64	
65	
66	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
67	# 1. Perplexity evaluation
68	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
69	
70	def load_eval_texts(args):
71	    """Yield texts from local JSONL or streaming FineWeb until token budget is reached."""
72	    if args.eval_data_path:
73	        with open(args.eval_data_path, "r") as f:
74	            for line in f:
75	                rec = json.loads(line)
76	                yield rec["text"]
77	    else:
78	        ds = load_dataset(
79	            "HuggingFaceFW/fineweb",
80	            name=args.fineweb_subset,
81	            split="train",
82	            streaming=True,
83	        )
84	        for ex in ds:
85	            text = ex.get("text", "")
86	            if text and len(text.split()) > 30:
87	                yield text
88	
89	
90	def evaluate_perplexity(model, tokenizer, args):
91	    """Sliding-window perplexity on held-out data."""
92	    stride = args.max_length // 2
93	    device = model.device
94	
95	    total_nll = 0.0
96	    total_tokens = 0
97	    doc_results = []
98	    tokens_seen = 0
99	
100	    for text in tqdm(load_eval_texts(args), desc="Perplexity", unit="doc"):
101	        if tokens_seen >= args.num_eval_tokens:
102	            break
103	
104	        encodings = tokenizer(text, return_tensors="pt", truncation=False)
105	        input_ids = encodings.input_ids[0]
106	        seq_len = input_ids.size(0)
107	
108	        if seq_len < 2:
109	            continue
110	
111	        doc_nll = 0.0
112	        doc_tokens = 0
113	
114	        for begin in range(0, seq_len, stride):
115	            end = min(begin + args.max_length, seq_len)
116	            target_begin = max(begin, stride) if begin > 0 else 1
117	
118	            ids = input_ids[begin:end].unsqueeze(0).to(device)
119	            target_ids = ids.clone()
120	            # Mask prefix tokens so loss is only on the non-overlapping part
121	            target_ids[0, : target_begin - begin] = -100
122	
123	            with torch.no_grad(), torch.amp.autocast("cuda"):
124	                outputs = model(ids, labels=target_ids)
125	
126	            n_tokens = (target_ids[0] != -100).sum().item()
127	            if n_tokens > 0:
128	                doc_nll += outputs.loss.float().item() * n_tokens
129	                doc_tokens += n_tokens
130	
131	            if end == seq_len:
132	                break
133	
134	        if doc_tokens > 0:
135	            doc_ppl = math.exp(doc_nll / doc_tokens)
136	            doc_results.append({
137	                "num_tokens": doc_tokens,
138	                "loss": doc_nll / doc_tokens,
139	                "perplexity": doc_ppl,
140	            })
141	            total_nll += doc_nll
142	            total_tokens += doc_tokens
143	            tokens_seen += doc_tokens
144	
145	    avg_loss = total_nll / total_tokens if total_tokens > 0 else float("inf")
146	    avg_ppl = math.exp(avg_loss) if avg_loss < 30 else float("inf")
147	
148	    summary = {
149	        "perplexity": avg_ppl,
150	        "loss": avg_loss,
151	        "total_tokens": total_tokens,
152	        "num_documents": len(doc_results),
153	    }
154	    return summary, doc_results
155	
156	
157	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
158	# 2. lm-eval-harness
159	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
160	
161	def evaluate_lm_eval(model_path, args):
162	    """Run lm-eval-harness benchmarks."""
163	    import lm_eval
164	
165	    model_name = args.model_name or model_path
166	    tasks = [t.strip() for t in args.lm_eval_tasks.split(",")]
167	    output_path = os.path.join(args.output_dir, "lm_eval_results")
168	    os.makedirs(output_path, exist_ok=True)
169	
170	    results = lm_eval.simple_evaluate(
171	        model="hf",
172	        model_args=f"pretrained={model_path},dtype=float16,trust_remote_code=True",
173	        tasks=tasks,
174	        batch_size=args.batch_size,
175	        random_seed=args.seed,
176	        numpy_random_seed=args.seed,
177	        torch_random_seed=args.seed,
178	        log_samples=True,
179	        output_path=output_path,
180	    )
181	
182	    summary = {}
183	    if "results" in results:
184	        for task_name, task_results in results["results"].items():
185	            task_summary = {}
186	            for metric, value in task_results.items():
187	                if isinstance(value, (int, float)):
188	                    task_summary[metric] = value
189	            summary[task_name] = task_summary
190	
191	    raw_path = os.path.join(output_path, "raw_results.json")
192	    with open(raw_path, "w") as f:
193	        json.dump(results.get("results", {}), f, indent=2, default=str)
194	
195	    return summary
196	
197	
198	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
199	# 3. Generation quality
200	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
201	
202	def generate_samples(model, tokenizer, args):
203	    """Generate text samples for diversity evaluation."""
204	    device = model.device
205	    prompts = [tokenizer.bos_token or ""] * args.num_generation_samples
206	    samples = []
207	    gen_batch = min(args.batch_size, 32)
208	
209	    for i in tqdm(range(0, len(prompts), gen_batch), desc="Generating", unit="batch"):
210	        batch_prompts = prompts[i : i + gen_batch]
211	        inputs = tokenizer(
212	            batch_prompts,
213	            return_tensors="pt",
214	            padding=True,
215	        ).to(device)
216	
217	        with torch.no_grad(), torch.amp.autocast("cuda"):
218	            output_ids = model.generate(
219	                **inputs,
220	                max_new_tokens=256,
221	                do_sample=True,
222	                temperature=0.8,
223	                top_p=0.95,
224	                pad_token_id=tokenizer.pad_token_id,
225	            )
226	
227	        for j, ids in enumerate(output_ids):
228	            prompt_len = inputs["input_ids"].shape[1]
229	            gen_text = tokenizer.decode(ids[prompt_len:], skip_special_tokens=True)
230	            samples.append(gen_text)
231	
232	    return samples
233	
234	
235	def tokenize_for_bleu(text):
236	    return text.lower().split()
237	
238	
239	def sentence_bleu_4gram(hypothesis, reference):
240	    """Compute 4-gram BLEU between two tokenized sentences (no brevity penalty clipping to avoid log(0))."""
241	    hyp_len = len(hypothesis)
242	    ref_len = len(reference)
243	    if hyp_len == 0:
244	        return 0.0
245	
246	    scores = []
247	    for n in range(1, 5):
248	        if hyp_len < n:
249	            scores.append(0.0)
250	            continue
251	        hyp_ngrams = Counter(tuple(hypothesis[i : i + n]) for i in range(hyp_len - n + 1))
252	        ref_ngrams = Counter(tuple(reference[i : i + n]) for i in range(ref_len - n + 1))
253	        clipped = sum(min(c, ref_ngrams[ng]) for ng, c in hyp_ngrams.items())
254	        total = sum(hyp_ngrams.values())
255	        scores.append(clipped / total if total > 0 else 0.0)
256	
257	    if any(s == 0 for s in scores):
258	        return 0.0
259	
260	    log_avg = sum(math.log(s) for s in scores) / 4.0
261	    bp = min(1.0, math.exp(1.0 - ref_len / hyp_len)) if hyp_len > 0 else 0.0
262	    return bp * math.exp(log_avg)
263	
264	
265	def compute_self_bleu(samples, max_pairs=5000):
266	    """Average pairwise 4-gram BLEU over a subsample of pairs."""
267	    tokenized = [tokenize_for_bleu(s) for s in samples if s.strip()]
268	    if len(tokenized) < 2:
269	        return 0.0
270	
271	    n = len(tokenized)
272	    if n * (n - 1) // 2 <= max_pairs:
273	        pairs = [(i, j) for i in range(n) for j in range(i + 1, n)]
274	    else:
275	        pairs = set()
276	        while len(pairs) < max_pairs:
277	            i, j = random.sample(range(n), 2)
278	            pairs.add((min(i, j), max(i, j)))
279	        pairs = list(pairs)
280	
281	    total = sum(sentence_bleu_4gram(tokenized[i], tokenized[j]) for i, j in tqdm(pairs, desc="Self-BLEU", unit="pair"))
282	    return total / len(pairs)
283	
284	
285	def compute_distinct_n(samples, max_n=3):
286	    """Distinct-n: ratio of unique n-grams to total n-grams across all samples."""
287	    results = {}
288	    all_tokens = []
289	    for s in samples:
290	        all_tokens.extend(tokenize_for_bleu(s))
291	
292	    for n in range(1, max_n + 1):
293	        ngrams = [tuple(all_tokens[i : i + n]) for i in range(len(all_tokens) - n + 1)]
294	        if not ngrams:
295	            results[f"distinct_{n}"] = 0.0
296	            continue
297	        results[f"distinct_{n}"] = len(set(ngrams)) / len(ngrams)
298	    return results
299	
300	
301	def evaluate_generation(model, tokenizer, args):
302	    """Run generation quality metrics."""
303	    samples = generate_samples(model, tokenizer, args)
304	
305	    self_bleu = compute_self_bleu(samples)
306	    distinct = compute_distinct_n(samples)
307	
308	    sample_path = os.path.join(args.output_dir, "generation_samples.jsonl")
309	    with open(sample_path, "w") as f:
310	        for i, text in enumerate(samples):
311	            f.write(json.dumps({"index": i, "text": text}, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")
312	
313	    summary = {"self_bleu": self_bleu, **distinct, "num_samples": len(samples)}
314	    return summary
315	
316	
317	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
318	# Main
319	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
320	
321	def main():
322	    args = parse_args()
323	    random.seed(args.seed)
324	    torch.manual_seed(args.seed)
325	    os.makedirs(args.output_dir, exist_ok=True)

"""
Evaluation pipeline for pretrained language models.

Three evaluation axes:
  1. Perplexity on held-out FineWeb — measures language modeling quality.
     Uses sliding-window evaluation (stride = max_length // 2) for long docs.
  2. lm-eval-harness benchmarks (HellaSwag, MMLU) — measures downstream task quality.
     Calls lm_eval.simple_evaluate for standardized, reproducible evaluation.
  3. Generation quality — measures output diversity via Self-BLEU and Distinct-n.
     Self-BLEU: average pairwise 4-gram BLEU across 1000 generated texts (lower = more diverse).
     Distinct-n: ratio of unique n-grams to total n-grams for n=1,2,3 (higher = more diverse).

Outputs:
  eval_results.json        — all metrics in one dict
  perplexity_details.json  — per-document perplexity breakdown
  generation_samples.jsonl — generated texts with metadata
  lm_eval_results/         — raw lm-eval-harness output
"""

import argparse
import json
import math
import os
import random
from collections import Counter
from pathlib import Path

import torch
from datasets import load_dataset
from tqdm import tqdm
from transformers import AutoModelForCausalLM, AutoTokenizer


def parse_args():
    p = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Evaluate a pretrained language model.")
    p.add_argument("--model_path", type=str, required=True,
                   help="Path to the model checkpoint directory")
    p.add_argument("--model_name", type=str, default=None,
                   help="Model name for lm-eval-harness (defaults to model_path)")
    p.add_argument("--output_dir", type=str, required=True,
                   help="Directory to save evaluation results")
    p.add_argument("--eval_data_path", type=str, default=None,
                   help="Local path to held-out eval data (JSONL with 'text' field)")
    p.add_argument("--fineweb_subset", type=str, default="sample-10BT",
                   help="FineWeb subset for streaming eval if eval_data_path is not set")
    p.add_argument("--num_eval_tokens", type=int, default=5_000_000,
                   help="Approximate number of tokens to evaluate perplexity on")
    p.add_argument("--max_length", type=int, default=2048,
                   help="Maximum sequence length for perplexity evaluation")
    p.add_argument("--batch_size", type=int, default=4,
                   help="Evaluation batch size")
    p.add_argument("--run_perplexity", type=lambda x: x.lower() != "false",
                   default=True, help="Run perplexity evaluation")
    p.add_argument("--run_lm_eval", type=lambda x: x.lower() != "false",
                   default=True, help="Run lm-eval-harness benchmarks")
    p.add_argument("--run_generation", type=lambda x: x.lower() != "false",
                   default=True, help="Run generation quality evaluation")
    p.add_argument("--lm_eval_tasks", type=str, default="hellaswag,mmlu",
                   help="Comma-separated lm-eval tasks")
    p.add_argument("--num_generation_samples", type=int, default=1000,
                   help="Number of texts to generate for diversity metrics")
    p.add_argument("--seed", type=int, default=42, help="Random seed")
    return p.parse_args()


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Perplexity evaluation
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def load_eval_texts(args):
    """Yield texts from local JSONL or streaming FineWeb until token budget is reached."""
    if args.eval_data_path:
        with open(args.eval_data_path, "r") as f:
            for line in f:
                rec = json.loads(line)
                yield rec["text"]
    else:
        ds = load_dataset(
            "HuggingFaceFW/fineweb",
            name=args.fineweb_subset,
            split="train",
            streaming=True,
        )
        for ex in ds:
            text = ex.get("text", "")
            if text and len(text.split()) > 30:
                yield text


def evaluate_perplexity(model, tokenizer, args):
    """Sliding-window perplexity on held-out data."""
    stride = args.max_length // 2
    device = model.device

    total_nll = 0.0
    total_tokens = 0
    doc_results = []
    tokens_seen = 0

    for text in tqdm(load_eval_texts(args), desc="Perplexity", unit="doc"):
        if tokens_seen >= args.num_eval_tokens:
            break

        encodings = tokenizer(text, return_tensors="pt", truncation=False)
        input_ids = encodings.input_ids[0]
        seq_len = input_ids.size(0)

        if seq_len < 2:
            continue

        doc_nll = 0.0
        doc_tokens = 0

        for begin in range(0, seq_len, stride):
            end = min(begin + args.max_length, seq_len)
            target_begin = max(begin, stride) if begin > 0 else 1

            ids = input_ids[begin:end].unsqueeze(0).to(device)
            target_ids = ids.clone()
            # Mask prefix tokens so loss is only on the non-overlapping part
            target_ids[0, : target_begin - begin] = -100

            with torch.no_grad(), torch.amp.autocast("cuda"):
                outputs = model(ids, labels=target_ids)

            n_tokens = (target_ids[0] != -100).sum().item()
            if n_tokens > 0:
                doc_nll += outputs.loss.float().item() * n_tokens
                doc_tokens += n_tokens

            if end == seq_len:
                break

        if doc_tokens > 0:
            doc_ppl = math.exp(doc_nll / doc_tokens)
            doc_results.append({
                "num_tokens": doc_tokens,
                "loss": doc_nll / doc_tokens,
                "perplexity": doc_ppl,
            })
            total_nll += doc_nll
            total_tokens += doc_tokens
            tokens_seen += doc_tokens

    avg_loss = total_nll / total_tokens if total_tokens > 0 else float("inf")
    avg_ppl = math.exp(avg_loss) if avg_loss < 30 else float("inf")

    summary = {
        "perplexity": avg_ppl,
        "loss": avg_loss,
        "total_tokens": total_tokens,
        "num_documents": len(doc_results),
    }
    return summary, doc_results


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. lm-eval-harness
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def evaluate_lm_eval(model_path, args):
    """Run lm-eval-harness benchmarks."""
    import lm_eval

    model_name = args.model_name or model_path
    tasks = [t.strip() for t in args.lm_eval_tasks.split(",")]
    output_path = os.path.join(args.output_dir, "lm_eval_results")
    os.makedirs(output_path, exist_ok=True)

    results = lm_eval.simple_evaluate(
        model="hf",
        model_args=f"pretrained={model_path},dtype=float16,trust_remote_code=True",
        tasks=tasks,
        batch_size=args.batch_size,
        random_seed=args.seed,
        numpy_random_seed=args.seed,
        torch_random_seed=args.seed,
        log_samples=True,
        output_path=output_path,
    )

    summary = {}
    if "results" in results:
        for task_name, task_results in results["results"].items():
            task_summary = {}
            for metric, value in task_results.items():
                if isinstance(value, (int, float)):
                    task_summary[metric] = value
            summary[task_name] = task_summary

    raw_path = os.path.join(output_path, "raw_results.json")
    with open(raw_path, "w") as f:
        json.dump(results.get("results", {}), f, indent=2, default=str)

    return summary


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Generation quality
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def generate_samples(model, tokenizer, args):
    """Generate text samples for diversity evaluation."""
    device = model.device
    prompts = [tokenizer.bos_token or ""] * args.num_generation_samples
    samples = []
    gen_batch = min(args.batch_size, 32)

    for i in tqdm(range(0, len(prompts), gen_batch), desc="Generating", unit="batch"):
        batch_prompts = prompts[i : i + gen_batch]
        inputs = tokenizer(
            batch_prompts,
            return_tensors="pt",
            padding=True,
        ).to(device)

        with torch.no_grad(), torch.amp.autocast("cuda"):
            output_ids = model.generate(
                **inputs,
                max_new_tokens=256,
                do_sample=True,
                temperature=0.8,
                top_p=0.95,
                pad_token_id=tokenizer.pad_token_id,
            )

        for j, ids in enumerate(output_ids):
            prompt_len = inputs["input_ids"].shape[1]
            gen_text = tokenizer.decode(ids[prompt_len:], skip_special_tokens=True)
            samples.append(gen_text)

    return samples


def tokenize_for_bleu(text):
    return text.lower().split()


def sentence_bleu_4gram(hypothesis, reference):
    """Compute 4-gram BLEU between two tokenized sentences (no brevity penalty clipping to avoid log(0))."""
    hyp_len = len(hypothesis)
    ref_len = len(reference)
    if hyp_len == 0:
        return 0.0

    scores = []
    for n in range(1, 5):
        if hyp_len < n:
            scores.append(0.0)
            continue
        hyp_ngrams = Counter(tuple(hypothesis[i : i + n]) for i in range(hyp_len - n + 1))
        ref_ngrams = Counter(tuple(reference[i : i + n]) for i in range(ref_len - n + 1))
        clipped = sum(min(c, ref_ngrams[ng]) for ng, c in hyp_ngrams.items())
        total = sum(hyp_ngrams.values())
        scores.append(clipped / total if total > 0 else 0.0)

    if any(s == 0 for s in scores):
        return 0.0

    log_avg = sum(math.log(s) for s in scores) / 4.0
    bp = min(1.0, math.exp(1.0 - ref_len / hyp_len)) if hyp_len > 0 else 0.0
    return bp * math.exp(log_avg)


def compute_self_bleu(samples, max_pairs=5000):
    """Average pairwise 4-gram BLEU over a subsample of pairs."""
    tokenized = [tokenize_for_bleu(s) for s in samples if s.strip()]
    if len(tokenized) < 2:
        return 0.0

    n = len(tokenized)
    if n * (n - 1) // 2 <= max_pairs:
        pairs = [(i, j) for i in range(n) for j in range(i + 1, n)]
    else:
        pairs = set()
        while len(pairs) < max_pairs:
            i, j = random.sample(range(n), 2)
            pairs.add((min(i, j), max(i, j)))
        pairs = list(pairs)

    total = sum(sentence_bleu_4gram(tokenized[i], tokenized[j]) for i, j in tqdm(pairs, desc="Self-BLEU", unit="pair"))
    return total / len(pairs)


def compute_distinct_n(samples, max_n=3):
    """Distinct-n: ratio of unique n-grams to total n-grams across all samples."""
    results = {}
    all_tokens = []
    for s in samples:
        all_tokens.extend(tokenize_for_bleu(s))

    for n in range(1, max_n + 1):
        ngrams = [tuple(all_tokens[i : i + n]) for i in range(len(all_tokens) - n + 1)]
        if not ngrams:
            results[f"distinct_{n}"] = 0.0
            continue
        results[f"distinct_{n}"] = len(set(ngrams)) / len(ngrams)
    return results


def evaluate_generation(model, tokenizer, args):
    """Run generation quality metrics."""
    samples = generate_samples(model, tokenizer, args)

    self_bleu = compute_self_bleu(samples)
    distinct = compute_distinct_n(samples)

    sample_path = os.path.join(args.output_dir, "generation_samples.jsonl")
    with open(sample_path, "w") as f:
        for i, text in enumerate(samples):
            f.write(json.dumps({"index": i, "text": text}, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")

    summary = {"self_bleu": self_bleu, **distinct, "num_samples": len(samples)}
    return summary


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Main
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def main():
    args = parse_args()
    random.seed(args.seed)
    torch.manual_seed(args.seed)
    os.makedirs(args.output_dir, exist_ok=True)

    results = {}

    print(f"Loading model from {args.model_path}")
    tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(args.model_path, trust_remote_code=True)
    if tokenizer.pad_token is None:
        tokenizer.pad_token = tokenizer.eos_token

    model = AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained(
        args.model_path,
        torch_dtype=torch.float16,
        device_map="auto",
        trust_remote_code=True,
    )
    model.eval()

    if args.run_perplexity:
        print("\n=== Perplexity Evaluation ===")
        ppl_summary, ppl_details = evaluate_perplexity(model, tokenizer, args)
        results["perplexity"] = ppl_summary
        detail_path = os.path.join(args.output_dir, "perplexity_details.json")
        with open(detail_path, "w") as f:
            json.dump(ppl_details, f, indent=2)
        print(f"Perplexity: {ppl_summary['perplexity']:.2f}  Loss: {ppl_summary['loss']:.4f}")

    if args.run_lm_eval:
        print("\n=== lm-eval-harness ===")
        try:
            lm_summary = evaluate_lm_eval(args.model_path, args)
            results["lm_eval"] = lm_summary
            for task, metrics in lm_summary.items():
                print(f"  {task}: {metrics}")
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"lm-eval-harness failed: {e}")
            results["lm_eval"] = {"error": str(e)}

    if args.run_generation:
        print("\n=== Generation Quality ===")
        gen_summary = evaluate_generation(model, tokenizer, args)
        results["generation"] = gen_summary
        print(f"Self-BLEU: {gen_summary['self_bleu']:.4f}")
        for k, v in gen_summary.items():
            if k.startswith("distinct_"):
                print(f"  {k}: {v:.4f}")

    results_path = os.path.join(args.output_dir, "eval_results.json")
    with open(results_path, "w") as f:
        json.dump(results, f, indent=2)

    print(f"\nResults saved to {results_path}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Evaluate perplexity on multiple eval sets using sliding-window method."""
import argparse
import json
import math
import time
import torch
from pathlib import Path
from transformers import AutoModelForCausalLM, AutoTokenizer

def eval_ppl(model, tokenizer, data_path, max_docs=5000, max_length=2048, stride=1024):
    total_nll = 0.0
    total_tokens = 0
    n_docs = 0
    
    with open(data_path) as f:
        for line in f:
            if n_docs >= max_docs:
                break
            text = json.loads(line)["text"]
            enc = tokenizer(text, return_tensors="pt", truncation=False)
            input_ids = enc.input_ids[0]
            seq_len = input_ids.size(0)
            if seq_len < 2:
                continue
            
            for begin in range(0, seq_len, stride):
                end = min(begin + max_length, seq_len)
                target_begin = max(begin, stride) if begin > 0 else 1
                ids = input_ids[begin:end].unsqueeze(0).to(model.device)
                labels = ids.clone()
                labels[0, :target_begin - begin] = -100
                
                with torch.no_grad(), torch.amp.autocast("cuda"):
                    loss = model(ids, labels=labels).loss
                
                n_tok = (labels[0] != -100).sum().item()
                if n_tok > 0:
                    total_nll += loss.float().item() * n_tok
                    total_tokens += n_tok
                if end == seq_len:
                    break
            n_docs += 1
    
    avg_loss = total_nll / total_tokens if total_tokens > 0 else float("inf")
    ppl = math.exp(avg_loss) if avg_loss < 30 else float("inf")
    return {"loss": avg_loss, "perplexity": ppl, "num_tokens": total_tokens, "num_docs": n_docs}

def main():
    p = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    p.add_argument("--model_path", required=True)
    p.add_argument("--eval_sets", required=True, help="comma-separated name:path pairs, e.g. fineweb:data/eval.jsonl,owt:data/owt.jsonl")
    p.add_argument("--output_path", required=True)
    p.add_argument("--max_docs", type=int, default=5000)
    p.add_argument("--max_length", type=int, default=2048)
    p.add_argument("--stride", type=int, default=1024)
    args = p.parse_args()
    
    print(f"Loading model: {args.model_path}")
    tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(args.model_path, trust_remote_code=True)
    model = AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained(
        args.model_path, torch_dtype=torch.float16, device_map="auto", trust_remote_code=True
    )
    model.eval()
    
    results = {}
    for spec in args.eval_sets.split(","):
        name, path = spec.split(":")
        print(f"\nEvaluating {name} ({path})...")
        t0 = time.time()
        r = eval_ppl(model, tokenizer, path, args.max_docs, args.max_length, args.stride)
        r["elapsed_seconds"] = round(time.time() - t0, 1)
        results[name] = r
        print(f"  PPL={r['perplexity']:.4f}  Loss={r['loss']:.4f}  Tokens={r['num_tokens']}  Time={r['elapsed_seconds']}s")
    
    Path(args.output_path).parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with open(args.output_path, "w") as f:
        json.dump(results, f, indent=2)
    print(f"\nResults saved to {args.output_path}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
SCRIPT
